name: OpenWA
description: OpenWA is a free, self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway with a built-in dashboard. Pair WhatsApp numbers as sessions by QR code, then send and receive messages over a REST API, webhooks, an MCP server and plugins.

notes.text: Sign in to the dashboard with the admin API key (API_MASTER_KEY in /opt/openwa_data/.env).
WhatsApp Web sessions use an unofficial protocol; WhatsApp can ban numbers used for bulk or automated messaging.

app_vars.name: var_api_key
app_vars.label: Admin API Key
app_vars.help: At least 32 characters; generated when left empty
